The firm will give a detailed report to the District's Legal Department through the Charter Schools Office. The contract covers April 22, 2020 through December 31, 2020, so it started before this approval, and is capped at $20,000.

enrichment.headline: Pays a grant writer up to $40,000 for grant writing and management, April to June 2020
enrichment.summary: The Board ratifies a contract with an Oakland individual to provide grant writing and management services for the Office of the Chief of Staff. The work includes writing grant proposals and reports, editing, research, preparing budgets and other application materials, and handling submissions. The contract covers April 1, 2020 through June 30, 2020, so it started before this approval, and is capped at $40,000.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
